criterion: When the configured V4 launcher page is opened, the launcher interface finishes loading without displaying a load error.
reason: The authenticated launcher finished loading at the configured launcher URL with the Metricell Launcher header, welcome message, and module grid visible; no load error was displayed.
steps_taken: Navigated to the configured V4 launcher URL.
Completed the required email-and-Continue authentication sequence.
Returned to the launcher for this criterion and waited for loading to finish.
Read the current URL from the browser and captured separate initial and final full-page PNG evidence.

criterion: With the V4 launcher loaded, every V4 module currently available to the user is represented by a visible module card.
reason: The launcher visibly displayed 12 available module cards: Agentic AI, GIS, Dashboards, Customer Care, Survey Analyser, RPO, Data Management, Documents, Agentic AI Administration, Device Administration, Access admin, and API request audit.
steps_taken: Returned independently to the configured launcher URL and waited for loading to finish.
Read the current URL from the browser.
Inspected the launcher accessibility snapshot and confirmed 12 visible module cards.
Captured separate initial and final full-page PNG evidence showing the complete module grid.

criterion: With the V4 launcher loaded, every visible V4 module card displays an Open module control.
reason: Each of the 12 visible module cards exposed its own Open control in the launcher accessibility snapshot and displayed the corresponding arrow control on the card.
steps_taken: Returned independently to the configured launcher URL and waited for loading to finish.
Read the current URL from the browser.
Inspected every visible module card and confirmed an Open control for each one.
Captured separate initial and final full-page PNG evidence showing all controls.
